description:
The global standard in heavy duty industrial trikes, with 20 inch wheels and a SINGLE SPEED coaster brake.

Single Speed Worksman Mover Industrial Tricycle w/ 20" Wheels all around (Very Popular!). Front Drum Brake and Rear Coaster (foot) Brake. Lowest Center of Gravity of all Movers. These Bikes are not toys. These are authentic Worksman Industrial Bicycles. Remember, choose Worksman because you want the best industrial bicycles on earth, with components that are more heavy duty than any other bicycles. Don't be fooled by other so-called heavy duty brands. Worksman uses tough rims, 11g (.120) spokes, and fully welded one-piece frames made of super durable oversized heavy gauge tubing and so many other features that set us apart as the world leader. Also, all Worksman Industrial Cycles are proudly made in our Solar Powered USA factory where we carefully weld and paint our frames, assemble the wheels, install all parts and hand build a cycle that will last for decades. Worksman Mover(tm) Tricycles are proudly Made in the USA. Now ALL Worksman Mover tricycles are available with Electric Hub Drive Power On Demand system for those who need a little boost or are traveling great distances. See Options menu. Ships Via Truck 85% assembled.
